name: Lightning air termination
summary: A rod or mesh conductor on top of a structure intended to intercept lightning strikes before they hit the structure.
description: The air termination is the capture device of a lightning protection system. It can be a vertical rod, a stretched wire or a roof mesh. Roof plans mark rods at their positions, and the protected zone around them is set by the design method used.

The symbol does not show height, protective angle or the design method. Rooftop equipment such as solar arrays and air conditioning plant within the protected zone may still need bonding or separation, which should appear on the lightning protection layout.
readingNotes: Check rooftop equipment against the protected zone.
Read rod heights from the layout notes.
drawingChecklist: State rod height or mesh size.
distinction: An air termination captures the strike; a surge arrester limits overvoltage on electrical conductors.
